WorkflowCoach is NovaLearn AI’s upcoming guided workflow assistant, designed to coach employees step‑by‑step through complex, multi‑step procedures rather than only answering static questions [NL-002#NL-002-S07]. It is currently in a restricted private beta enabled for approximately 11% of active customers, primarily mid‑market logistics and enterprise manufacturing clients such as Acme Manufacturing, testing factory‑floor safety checks and assembly line onboarding [NL-002#NL-002-S07] [NL-014#NL-014-S05].

The official public product roadmap targets a public beta in September 2026, with the v2.9.0 release scheduled for September 29, 2026 [NL-014#NL-014-S03]. Internal engineering and leadership reviews indicate that the September target is at risk due to dependencies on the Advanced OCR Pipeline and Okta permission synchronization engine, and the public beta may slip to November 2026 [NL-002#NL-002-S07] [NL-014#NL-014-S05]. The CTO’s realistic engineering estimate is November 2026, citing high latency during step transitions (up to 4 seconds) and permission inheritance issues where restricted documents referenced by public SOPs may not be hidden from unauthorized users [NL-015#NL-015-S05]. A September private beta for selected non‑regulated clients is being considered as a contingency, but no final public decision has been confirmed in the evidence [NL-015#NL-015-S05] [NL-015#NL-015-S08].

Planned capabilities include ingesting procedural documents from KnowledgeHub, parsing them into sequential steps, prompting users to confirm completion via checkboxes, regex text entry, or OCR‑validated photo uploads, and recording timestamps, user IDs, and input payloads in a write‑once PostgreSQL compliance log [NL-014#NL-014-S03]. Feedback from the private beta has highlighted the need for offline caching of step lists and automated photo verification of physical tasks [NL-014#NL-014-S05]. Until the public beta, WorkflowCoach remains restricted to approved pilot accounts, and the development timeline is subject to modification based on QA testing results [NL-002#NL-002-S07].
